verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of SKILL.md instruction files that plug into external agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot). A skill library has no product surface of its own in which to embed an AI assistant, so asking whether it ships one is a category error. The delegation the evidence describes, such as sub-agent dispatch and agent-ready briefs, is carried out by the host agent, so it cannot be credited as a built-in assistant of this product.
